name: ask
eval: const a=document.querySelector('textarea');a.value='Quelle est la capitale de l\'Espagne ? Un mot.';a.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));document.querySelector('button.send').click(); return true

name: sidebar opens, and closes on choosing a discussion
eval: const sb=document.querySelector('.sidebar'); document.querySelector('.topbar button').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const opened=!sb.classList.contains('collapsed'); sb.querySelector('.side-section:last-of-type .item:not(.new-item), .item.active, .side-scroll .item:not(.new-item)').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); return [opened, sb.classList.contains('collapsed')]

name: settings fit
eval: [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.title==='Paramètres'||b.innerText.trim()==='Paramètres').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const d=document.querySelector('.dialog').getBoundingClientRect(); return d.width<=innerWidth && d.left>=0
